rdfs:label: IndirectContainer
rdfs:comment: An LDP Container whose membership triples reference an indirected member resource via `insertedContentRelation`.
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Container`. The most flexible LDP container type — when a new resource is POSTed, the server uses `ldp:insertedContentRelation` to extract the value to use as the actual membership target. Not required by the Solid Protocol (servers need only support ldp:BasicContainer); rarely available on Solid servers.

examples.title: An indirect container: each POSTed document's foaf:primaryTopic becomes a foaf:knows of Alice

history.note: Example uses foaf:knows/foaf:primaryTopic instead of nonexistent schema:likedBy; notes: not required by Solid Protocol.
